subject: OrbitEdge pilot qualification — recap, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orbitedge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitEdge pilot qualification — recap, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks again for the call today, Sanjay — really appreciate you walking us through the primary workloads and the evaluation team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please confirm or flag anything missing.

1) Scope (what you showed today)
- Streaming customer support transcripts (avg session: 420 tokens)
- Inference patterns: 70% short requests (<64 tokens), 30% long (up to 2,048 tokens)
- Targets: real-time suggestions in support UI and nightly re-ranking for top-100 cases

2) Proposed pilot goals (high-level)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 400ms for short requests in a dedicated setup
- Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent short requests/sec with <= 10% queueing
- Cost: target <= $0.0018 per token (avg) across pilot workload when using recommended quantized model+batching
- Quality: end-to-end accuracy / relevance baseline to beat current rule-based scorer by +12% as judged on the provided eval set

3) Measurement plan and owners
- Redwood will instrument token-level latency and cost, provide test harness and KV prefix caching configuration (Ben).
- OrbitEdge to provide a 3-day sample workload and the labeled eval set (Sanjay).
- Success decision will be a joint readout at the end of the 3-week pilot (Marissa + OrbitEdge product lead).

4) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope, sign SOW/PO triggers
- Week 1: environment setup + sample workload ingest
- Week 2: smoke runs and tuning (batch/quantization)
- Week 3: steady-state runs, evaluation, joint readout

5) Asks from you now
- Confirm the workload sample availability and a primary product contact for the readout.
- If procurement needs a PO threshold to start (or contract redlines), loop them in so we can align on dates.

I'll attach a draft pilot scope and a short runbook. Happy to jump on a 20m call tomorrow to finalize the SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood-orbitedge-poc-scope.pdf

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orbitedge.ai>

Cc: Emily Chen <emilyc@orbitedge.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitEdge pilot qualification — recap, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa — clear and helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 2,048-token path is for batch re-ranking only; UX requests should rarely touch that. The short request SLA is our priority.
- We can provide a 72-hour sample workload by EOD Tuesday (will include traffic skew across product lines).
- On cost: the finance team historically budgets at $0.0022/token for PoCs; we'll need to show a clear path to your $0.0018 target to get fast approval.

Procurement note: Emily, is there a PO threshold (amount) that would allow OrbitEdge to sign a short pilot SOW without going to the full legal cycle? If yes, share the email for procurement so Marissa can confirm next steps.

Sanjay
CTO (Acting) | OrbitEdge

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orbitedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitEdge pilot qualification — recap, success criteria, and next steps

Appreciate the details, Sanjay — quick technical plan and acceptance criteria we propose for the pilot instrumentation: 

Measurement windows:
- Short requests: run 100k-200k sample short requests across a 48-hour steady-state window; record p50/p95/p99 latencies and token counts.
- Long/batch: submit nightly batch re-runs for three nights to measure throughput and GPU utilization.

Acceptance thresholds (concrete):
- Latency: p95 <= 400ms for short requests on dedicated instance type (gpus: a100-80g equiv). p99 alert threshold at 650ms.
- Throughput: sustained 120 short reqs/sec with no more than 10% of requests queued >100ms.
- Cost/token: measured end-to-end invoice estimate <= $0.0018/token using quantized T4-equivalent execution and our batching profile. We'll show run-level breakdowns (kernel time, queuing, prefix cache hit rates).
- Quality: we'll run your labeled eval set and provide precision/recall + qualitative failure samples. Target is +12% relevance lift vs your baseline; we also propose an SLA for regressions: if quality drops by >5% across the eval set after tuning, we pause rollout and investigate.

Runbook notes:
- We'll provide an instrumentation script and a Grafana dashboard (read-only) to OrbitEdge.
- Owner matrix: Ben = infra/config; Karthik = commercial/contract; Marissa = overall success owner and readout lead.

If that looks good, I'll drop the instrumentation repo link and a short checklist to the SOW attachment.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

- Billing/PO: capped spend estimate shown; we can start once OrbitEdge issues a PO for the pilot cap

Thanks — happy to take a short call to run through the SOW line-by-line if procurement requests it.

Best,
Marissa
